message.content: Based on the conversations shared, LiHua considers Lionel Messi to be the best soccer player due to several factors. Specifically, she highlights Messi's exceptional playmaking ability and his vision on the field, noting that he is able to create chances out of nothing. Additionally, LiHua points out Messi's incredible work ethic and humility, stating that these qualities inspire other players to strive for excellence. LiHua also mentions that Messi's influence extends beyond his own career, as he serves as an example and motivator for young soccer players.
